notes.title: The Bradwell Conspiracy Update #2
notes.content:
Hello Bradwell Players,

Today we have launched an update to The Bradwell Conspiracy that covers the following requested features and bug fixes:


 Level Select! Unlocks level by level throughout the game.

 More resolution options! Including 4k! Pick what your GPU can handle!

 Added language selection via command line: Right click The Bradwell Conspiracy in your Steam Library. Select preferences. In the launch options add "-lang" followed by your language of choice. For language codes please see the forum thread.

 Changes to the SMP rotation system - rotation persists regardless of object position

 Fixed object snapping on ledges

 UI Indicators appear in the correct positions

 Control sensitivity gets saved and persists

 Better dead zone to joystick controls

 Contextual movement sensitivity improvements - smooth sensitivity curve on analog inputs

 Blurry textures for letters

 D14 door now has a no-print symbol on the floor



If you have any further questions or need support please head over to the forums!
